faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1.question: Is my data really never sent anywhere?
faq.q1.answer: Correct. MaktabatyPro makes zero network requests. Everything — templates, filled documents, your PDF library — is processed and stored locally on your device in IndexedDB. You can disconnect from the internet entirely and every feature keeps working.
faq.q2.question: What happens after my 3-day trial ends?
faq.q2.answer: Your account and any templates you created stay on your device — they're just locked until you activate a paid license. Activating Standard or Multi unlocks everything instantly, with no reinstall needed.
faq.q3.question: Can I move my license to a new computer?
faq.q3.answer: Yes. Standard is licensed to one machine at a time — deactivate on the old device and activate on the new one from the same account. The Multi plan includes 2 machines, and you can add more anytime for +249 MAD each.
faq.q4.question: Can I upgrade from Standard to Multi later?
faq.q4.answer: Yes, at any time — contact us and pay only the difference between the two licenses. Your templates, library, and settings carry over automatically.
faq.q6.question: Which languages does the interface support?
faq.q6.answer: Arabic, French, Spanish and English, fully translated including right-to-left layout for Arabic. Switch languages anytime from the footer, even offline. and we will add more.
privacy.feature1.title: Zero network requests
privacy.feature1.text: Everything runs locally in your browser. No servers, no APIs, no telemetry. Disconnect from the internet entirely — it still works.
privacy.feature2.title: Local storage only
privacy.feature2.text: All data stored in IndexedDB on your machine. No cloud sync, no third-party storage. You control the backup — encrypted export files.
privacy.feature3.title: No account required
privacy.feature3.text: No sign-up, no email, no phone number. Download, open, use. Your administrative documents contain national IDs and private data — they should never need an account on someone else's server.
privacy.feature4.title: PDF encryption built-in
privacy.feature4.text: Password-protect exported PDFs with user and owner passwords. Control print, copy, and modification permissions.

ai.heading: Drop in a Word document. Get a working template.
ai.sub: Pick a source document and set the rules. The AI model writes the TemplateFlow template, which then flows straight into the live demo below, where you can fill it in and watch the document appear.
ai.step1x: First, remove real names and IDs from the source document. Then paste the cleaned text and tell the AI what you want.
ai.step2x: The AI parses the text, identifies every variable field, picks the right type (text, date, CIN, currency…) and adds validations and defaults.
ai.step3: Bring it back into the app
ai.step3x: Paste the template, pick the language (Arabic/French/English), customize with Google Fonts, and preview it live before saving.
ai.step4x: Save the template to your library, fill it manually or in bulk via Excel, then print or export PDF — fully offline.
ai.prompt: Source text (after removing names): "I, the undersigned: Mr/Ms ........, holder of national ID ........, born on ........". ← I want a declaration-of-honor template with the same fields.
ai.cta.x: Three ready-made templates below — Declaration of No Employment, Collective Life Declaration, and Declaration of Honor. Switch between them with one click and type your name to watch the document update live.
ai.note: Illustrative example. Review the template before using it, and edit it as you like — the AI suggests, you decide.
